verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a payments platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so consuming third-party MCP servers is a category error for this product type. Its documented MCP Server is the server role, where it exposes its own tools to AI IDEs, and does not make it an MCP client. Its agentic-commerce integrations have AI agents calling into Checkout.com, not Checkout.com using external tools.
